title: Words to read and colour: Reading from the mushaf
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 45 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 45. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Reading from the mushaf). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: Find the page
points: Near the end of the mushaf

arabic.text: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ (١) حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ (٢) كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ (٣) ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ (٤) كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٥) لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ (٦) ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ (٧) ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ (٨)

questions.q: Reading turns: today's group reads two ayat each from the mushaf. Everyone else follows with a finger.
questions.a: Each child reads from the page; stars recorded.

questions.q: Extend: read 102:5 to 8 to a grown-up from the mushaf.
The circle with a number at the end of an ayah tells us ...
questions.a: A) the ayah has ended. The ayah circle shows the end of an ayah and its number.

questions.q: Think again: This is your first time reading a whole passage from the mushaf! How does it feel?
questions.a: Exciting: we are reading Allah's Book ourselves. We say alhamdulillah.
